bullets.text: MagSafe Wallet Innovation - **SUPCASE** introduces a functional MagSafe Wallet with AirTag support and strong magnets.
Nest x Yale Lock Upgrade - **Google**'s new smart lock supports **Matter**, enhancing compatibility across smart home ecosystems.
iPhone Battery Life Champion - The **iPhone 17 Pro Max** outlasts the **Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra** in battery tests.
Portable Note-Taking Device - The **reMarkable Paper Pro Move** offers a compact design and excellent functionality for notes.
Solar-Powered Keyboard Launch - **Logitech** unveils the **Signature Slim Solar Plus K980**, a light-powered keyboard.
YouTube Policy Reversal - **Google** will allow creators banned for misinformation to return to **YouTube**.
AI-Powered Photo Editing - **Google Photos** now allows Android users to edit photos using natural language.
AI Data Centers Expansion - **OpenAI** partners with **Oracle** and **SoftBank** to build five new data centers.
Electric Truck Funding - **Telo** raises $20 million to develop compact electric trucks for urban environments.
AI Safety Legislation - California's **Scott Wiener** pushes for transparency in AI with new safety reporting requirements.
